urban_population.label: Urban population
urban_population.methodology: Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices. The data are collected and smoothed by United Nations Population Division.
urban_population.source_organization: World Urbanization Prospects, United Nations (UN), uri: https://population.un.org/wup/, note: United Nations Population Division's World Urbanization Prospects, National definitions, publisher: UN Population Division
urban_population.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
urban_population.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

population.label: Population
population.methodology: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. The values shown are midyear estimates.
population.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
population.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

gdp.label: GDP
gdp.methodology: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
gdp.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
gdp.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per person
gdp_per_capita.methodology: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. The core indicator has been divided by the general population to achieve a per capita estimate.This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
gdp_per_capita.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
gdp_per_capita.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

clean_cooking.label: Clean cooking access
clean_cooking.methodology: Access to clean fuels and technologies for cooking is the proportion of total population primarily using clean cooking fuels and technologies for cooking. Under WHO guidelines, kerosene is excluded from clean cooking fuels.
clean_cooking.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
clean_cooking.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

electricity_access.label: Electricity access
electricity_access.methodology: Access to electricity is the percentage of population with access to electricity. Electrification data are collected from industry, national surveys and international sources.
electricity_access.source_organization: SDG 7.1.1 Electrification Dataset, World Bank (WB), uri: https://trackingsdg7.esmap.org/downloads, note: Data is downloaded from ESMAP website. Data is released when a new Tracking SDG7 report is released., publisher: World Bank (WB), date accessed: 2024-05-16, date published: 2023
electricity_access.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
electricity_access.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

renewable_electricity.label: Renewable electricity generation
renewable_electricity.methodology: Renewable electricity is the share of electricity generated by renewable power plants in total electricity generated by all types of plants.
renewable_electricity.source_organization: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25
renewable_electricity.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
renewable_electricity.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

electricity_per_capita.label: Electricity consumption per person
electricity_per_capita.methodology: Electric power consumption measures the production of power plants and combined heat and power plants less transmission, distribution, and transformation losses and own use by heat and power plants.
electricity_per_capita.source_organization: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25
electricity_per_capita.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
electricity_per_capita.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

electricity_losses.label: Transmission and distribution losses
electricity_losses.methodology: Electric power transmission and distribution losses include losses in transmission between sources of supply and points of distribution and in the distribution to consumers, including pilferage. The losses are expressed as a share of the total output.
electricity_losses.source_organization: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25
electricity_losses.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
electricity_losses.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

land_area.label: Land area
land_area.methodology: Land area is a country's total area, excluding area under inland water bodies, national claims to continental shelf, and exclusive economic zones. In most cases the definition of inland water bodies includes major rivers and lakes.
land_area.source_organization: FAOSTAT, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/RL, publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
land_area.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
land_area.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider

energy_intensity.label: Primary energy intensity
energy_intensity.methodology: Energy intensity level of primary energy is the ratio between energy supply and gross domestic product measured at purchasing power parity. Energy intensity is an indication of how much energy is used to produce one unit of economic output. Lower ratio indicates that less energy is used to produce one unit of output.
energy_intensity.license: World Bank dataset terms; see source indicator for third-party conditions
energy_intensity.status: source-reported; estimates may be included by the provider
